- Quizzes are held during the **last 15 minutes of class**.
- Tests use the **full 75-minute class period**.
- Students with recognized accommodations will receive the testing
  arrangements specified in their accommodation letters.

## Rules for quizzes and tests

Unless the instructor explicitly says otherwise:

- Quizzes and tests are completed **individually**.
- For an application problem, you will **not** need to derive the linear
  system of equations unless the instructor tells you otherwise. When a
  derivation is not required, the linear system will be provided.
- Quizzes and tests are **closed book**, but you may use up to **four
  letter-sized sheets of paper** as memory aids. For the final examination,
  you may use up to **eight letter-sized sheets of paper**.
- Calculators and all other electronic devices—including phones,
  smartwatches, earbuds, tablets, and computers—are **not allowed**. Silence
  and place them in a bag under your desk or at the front of the room before
  the quiz or test begins.
- Use only materials explicitly permitted for that quiz or test. Do not share
  materials.
- Keep your attention on your own work. Do not communicate with another
  student, look at or copy another student's work, make your work available
  to another student, or give or receive assistance. Direct questions to the
  instructor.

Cheating or attempted cheating—including using an unauthorized device,
resource, or assistance—will be handled under the course
[Academic Integrity, Technology, and AI Usage policy](../classlib/classlib/quarto/pages/policies.qmd#academic-integrity-technology-and-ai-usage).

## Examples of question style from other courses

The archived assessments below come from MATH 476, MATH 563, and MATH 565
(Monte Carlo Methods in Finance). They are provided so that you can become
familiar with the instructor's style of questions. They are **not** MATH 332
practice tests: the topics, level, permitted materials, and course emphasis
differ, and archived files may contain errors.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

archive_root = Path("../assets/tests/archive")
courses = {
    "476": "MATH 476 — Statistics",
    "563": "MATH 563 — Mathematical Statistics",
    "565": "MATH 565 — Monte Carlo Methods in Finance",
}

for course, heading in courses.items():
    display(Markdown(f"### {heading}"))
    course_root = archive_root / course
    pdfs = (
        sorted(course_root.glob("*.pdf"), key=lambda path: path.name.lower())
        if course_root.exists()
        else []
    )
    if not pdfs:
        display(Markdown(f"*No archived {course} assessments found.*"))
        continue

    lines = []
    for path in pdfs:
        href = f"../assets/tests/archive/{course}/{quote(path.name)}"
        label = path.stem.replace("_", " ")
        lines.append(f"- [{label}]({href})")
    display(Markdown("\n".join(lines)))
```
